contact_edits.before: There's some confusion in the musical theatre and opera divisions: sometimes they overlap, sometimes they don't. Let me just note that best musical actor nominees include critical winners Bruce dow and darrin Baker (leading and supporting respectively, for us); that I wish some space could have been found for Christopher Siebert in La Cage Aux Folles, even if he was just passing through; and that I was glad to see Falsettos (musical) and Dialogue Aux Carmelites (opera) nominated for best production in their respective categories, though I was sad to see no mention of their respective directors, robert McQueen and robert Carsen. In the latter case, I'm more than sad; I'm incensed. Dialogue aux Carmelies was the COC's finest production of a fine season, maybe their finest production in years. It may also have been the best thing seen last season on any Toronto stage. robert.cushman@hotmail.com The Dora Awards are at the Bluma Appel Theatre on Monday June 24.
